meta.title: How it works & results — Saede
meta.description: Real results take time. Most women see first changes around three months, fuller results by six. Here is the honest timeline, and why we ask for the full course.

sections.heading: Real results take time.
sections.lead: Hair grows on its own schedule. Here is honestly what to expect, and how to get the most out of the months ahead.

sections.heading: What is actually happening underneath
paragraphs: Hair grows on a cycle. Each follicle spends years growing, then a short while resting, then it sheds and begins again. At any moment most of your hair is growing and a small share is resting.

When something disrupts that — stress, a hormonal shift, a nutrient your body has run short of — more follicles move into the resting phase than usually would. You do not see it straight away. You see it weeks or months later, in the shower.
That delay works in both directions, and it is the reassuring part: it means change is already happening underneath well before it shows in the mirror.

sections.eyebrow: Getting the most out of it
sections.heading: Getting the most out of it.
paragraphs: Saede is support. It sits on top of the basics rather than in place of them, and it will never do the work of a full, nourishing diet — nothing in a capsule can.

The things that make the biggest difference alongside it are the simple ones: **more protein**, **less sugar**, **movement you enjoy**, **regular sleep and rest**, and — the hardest of all — **slowing down a little**. Not a list to feel guilty about. Just the ground this stands on.
Members get the full briefing on all of it: the longer version, with the reasoning and the evidence gone through properly.

sections.heading: Give it the full course.
paragraphs: That is when it works. Membership is built around the three-month minimum for exactly this reason.
